_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic). METRIC fields come from message Metrics in common/metrics.proto (278 in v24); SEGMENT dimensions from message Segments in common/segments.proto (151 in v24; message-typed segments keyword/asset_interaction_target/sk_ad_network_source_app/budget_campaign_association_status flatten to their sub-fields, e.g. segments.keyword.info.text); STRUCTURAL dimensions (26: ids/names/status of the 5 profile resources: customer, campaign, ad_group, ad_group_ad, keyword_view via ad_group_criterion, search_term_view) are curated from the resource protos' attribute fields. GAQL has a single flat namespace: unlike Meta there is no fields-vs-breakdowns split -- segments and attributes go in the same SELECT as metrics, and the FROM resource decides legality.
_derivation.section_rule: Protos carry no sections. The generator assigns each field a section from the ordered prefix-family rules in build_official_fields.py (first match wins, transposed from the research draft), then Supermetrics section names are attached as enrichment labels only. Ratio/derived metrics (ctr, average_*, *_rate, *_share, cost_per_*, value_per_*) are cataloged with a NON-ADDITIVE note in their description (semantic-layer computed, AD-4); micros fields are int64 micros on the wire and landed as value/1e6 (platform micros rule).
_derivation.count_divergence: Official 278 metrics vs Supermetrics 153: they merge micros/value variants, expose computed ratios as single fields, lag on v24 families (all_* commerce, experiment stats) and park 14 metrics in DEPRECATED. Official 151 segments vs their 631 dimensions: Supermetrics counts RESOURCE ATTRIBUTES (ad copy components, asset fields, budget/quality-score attributes) as dimensions; in API terms those are attributes of ad_group_ad/asset/campaign_budget, not segments. Each API field is declared ONCE; enrichment-only ids are reported as suspects, never emitted. Supermetrics field ids are AdWords-era names that match official ids only fuzzily -- labels/descriptions enrichment only, never identity.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/google-ads-fields.md -o /tmp/google-ads-sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)
sources._parse_note: Each field is a nested-markdown-table blob duplicated once escaped: keep only lines matching '^| \| <id> \|' whose id != 'Field label' (784 fields = 153 metrics + 631 dimensions incl. 41 in DEPRECATED, snapshot updated 2026-07-16). Sections feed tier labels; field ids are Supermetrics-internal (AdWords-era names like Currencycode/ActiveViewImpressions) and match official ids only fuzzily -- enrichment labels/descriptions only, never identity.

probe.structural_note: GAQL SELECT over a 1-day window on the selected client account: metrics batched 20 per query as 'SELECT segments.date, <batch> FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING YESTERDAY LIMIT 1' (FROM widened per field when the compatibility dump says the field is not legal on campaign); segments probed one at a time against their smallest legal resource with a single core metric. A rejected batch (400 QueryError PROHIBITED_*/UNRECOGNIZED_FIELD) is bisected so the exact offending field is captured. Manager accounts are never probed (REQUESTED_METRICS_FOR_MANAGER); login-customer-id resolved from topology.

field_compatibility._note: Core 26.1 contract (server/core/schemas/field-compatibility.schema.json, schema_version '1'): the loader validates this block at load time (Step 1b) and the connector enforces it PRE-CALL via core.field_compat.enforce_selection(selection, rules, context={'resource': <FROM resource>}) -- strict context by default. The 'rules' array is GENERATED by build_official_fields.py from official_fields.json + the _gaql_* metadata below (one selectable_set rule per v1 profile FROM resource; run the builder after any change to the metadata or the official snapshot). AUTHORITY once fetched = fieldservice_compat.json (per-FROM-resource legal metric/segment sets + per-field selectable_with, regenerated per version bump). Incompatible selections are refused BEFORE the API call (invalid_request -- PROHIBITED_SEGMENT_WITH_METRIC... must NEVER surface from the provider on a known rule). Metric legality per resource is NOT statically encoded (every metric is in every allowed_fields set): the live dump / 25.6 probe is the authority there.
field_compatibility._scoping_note: _gaql_resource_scoped_* values are the LIST of v1 profile FROM resources on which the segment is selectable ([] = selectable on NONE of them -- needs a resource outside the v1 profiles). Selecting a scoped segment on any other resource is refused pre-call. Prefix rules apply when the segment has no exact entry. The generator projects these into the allowed_fields of each selectable_set rule.
_gaql_invariants: Every report is implicitly segmented by the FROM resource's resource_name.
A selected core date segment REQUIRES a finite date range in WHERE (EXPECTED_FILTERS_ON_DATE_RANGE); the builder always adds segments.date BETWEEN.
Any non-core-date segment used in WHERE must also be in SELECT.
Date segments support at most a 37-month lookback since 2026-06-01 (backfill bound).
Metrics queries must target non-manager accounts (REQUESTED_METRICS_FOR_MANAGER / CANNOT_BE_EXECUTED_BY_MANAGER_ACCOUNT).
Zero-metric rows are omitted from results (DQ volume monitors must not treat absence as failure).

_row_restricting_segments.keyword: segments.keyword.* restricts rows to Search keyword-criterion traffic (silently excludes DSA/Shopping/PMax).
_row_restricting_segments.click_type: segments.click_type restricts rows to interactions attributable per click type and reshapes totals; excluded from the DEFAULT selection (review 26.2 F-3), selectable explicitly.
_row_restricting_segments.conversion_action*: segments.conversion_action* restricts rows to those with conversions and splits conversion metrics per action; never mix with plain volume metrics in one stored grain.
_row_restricting_segments.product_*: product_* segments only legal on shopping resources (shopping_performance_view).
_row_restricting_segments.sk_ad_network_*: iOS SKAN reporting only; campaign-level, coarse grain.

field_compatibility._row_restricting_note: Keys ending in '*' are prefixes, others exact segment names. _prune_default_selection excludes these from the selection=None fallback (a DEFAULT must never silently reshape the grain); an EXPLICIT user selection of these segments is honored (compat rules permitting).

excluded_sections.AUCTION INSIGHT: auction_insight_* metrics require the auction-insight report shape (segments.auction_insight_domain mandatory) which the daily pull profiles do not build; excluded until an auction_insight profile exists.
excluded_sections.EXPERIMENT: control_*/p_value/margin_of_error/point_estimate metrics only return rows on experiment-arm campaigns; excluded from default profiles (no request shape).
excluded_sections.SKAN: sk_ad_network_* requires iOS app campaigns and SKAN postback grain; excluded until an app-campaign profile exists.

_exposure_note: Story 26.2 (mirrors meta-ads 25.8): exposure = reachable through the profiles' GAQL request shape, and catalog_daily makes the whole selectable namespace reachable -- ZERO planned (story invariant). The three excluded sections need a report shape no profile builds (reason attached per field). Segments scoped to another FROM resource (product_*, hotel_*, vertical_ads_*, ...) stay exposed but are refused PRE-CALL by field_compatibility on the v1 profile resources; they become extractable when a profile with their FROM resource lands (they are legal API fields, not another report shape). Ratio/derived metrics are exposed with a NON-ADDITIVE description note and land raw at day grain (GSC average_position pattern) -- never summed (AD-4).
